info.title: ahang-khatkesh internal API
info.description: Private same-origin Laravel API. Session cookies and CSRF are required for writes. Admin reads require confirmed MFA; sensitive writes also require recent password and MFA confirmation. MySQL is authoritative; phpMyAdmin is an operator tool, not an API dependency.

tags.description: Private catalog, playback and personal library.

schema.description: At least one of role or is_active is required. Last active owner and actor privilege invariants apply.
